about: Rhianna M. Fronapfel attended law school and graduated from University of Washington School of Law in 2006. Rhianna Fronapfel began practicing law in 2007.

Rhianna Fronapfel is an attorney at Bennett Bigelow & Leedom, P.S., helping people with Personal Injury - Medical Malpractice: Defense issues. Bennett Bigelow & Leedom, P.S. has an office in Seattle, Washington, serving the local community.

Rhianna Fronapfel was selected to Super Lawyers for 2020 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
